preregistration: Frozen BEFORE any model was run. Tolerances, scoring rules, task wording and repeat counts must not change after results are seen; any change requires a new spec version and a logged deviation.
research_question: How effectively does the actual DecisionGPT system answer objective business-analytics questions over real Indian POS data, compared with an LLM given direct read-only access to the same data?

dataset.description: Indian POS retail register, 1 Jan-31 Mar 2025
dataset.provenance_limitation: Appears to be real Indian POS data from its structure and content; uploader/store provenance is NOT independently verified.
dataset.license: CC BY-NC-SA 4.0 (as recorded in the repository)
dataset.representativeness: NOT representative of Indian SMEs or Indian retail generally.

view_rules: 1) keep lines whose quantity is a whole number > 0 (sales.quantity is an integer column); 2) keep lines whose recomputed amount (qty*rate) agrees with a printed amount column; 3) merge lines that share (date, product, unit price) by summing quantity (the production upload validator rejects duplicate rows; merging preserves total sales and total units exactly; when a merged group mixed GST slabs, the slab with the largest revenue in the group is kept). Consequence: 'one row' no longer means 'one bill line', so no task asks about individual sale entries.

selection_rules.C04_product: 2nd-ranked product by total revenue over 1 Jan-31 Mar 2025
selection_rules.C05_products: 3rd- and 4th-ranked products by total units over 1 Jan-31 Mar 2025, listed alphabetically
selection_rules.C06_product: top-ranked product by total revenue over 1 Jan-31 Mar 2025

conditions.primary: DecisionGPT with the evaluation clock fixed at 2025-03-31 (emulates a user asking right after the data period; production code unmodified)
conditions.secondary: DecisionGPT with the real clock (a user asking about stale data); 'realclock'

systems.decisiongpt: POST /businesses/{id}/chat on a business created and filled through the production upload endpoints; the configured LLM only rephrases a computed template answer (production behaviour).
systems.llm_code_baseline: Protocol B2: the same configured LLM client, given the schema, sample rows and read-only access to the same data view through a sandboxed pandas snippet it writes itself (<=1 repair attempt), then phrases the executed result. No DecisionGPT routing/analytics.

information_given.decisiongpt: date, product, quantity, unit_price (and computed revenue) for every view line, via the production ingestion path. No GST column (cannot be stored).
information_given.llm_code_baseline: the same four fields plus computed revenue as a DataFrame; plus gst_pct ONLY for supplementary-track tasks. Never the ground truth, task metadata or tolerances.

scoring.numbers: primary = the ground truth appears among the numbers in the answer within tolerance (dates/years removed first; lakh/crore/K/M multipliers understood); secondary = first number only; n_numbers recorded
scoring.signed_change: a signed change is correct only if the magnitude is within tolerance AND the direction (up/down) matches; missing direction -> partially_correct
scoring.entities: first candidate entity named in the answer (products: names present in the view; weekdays; dates; GST slabs); secondary lenient metric: truth mentioned anywhere
scoring.ranking: primary = exact ordered top-k; secondary = top-1 correct and overlap@k
scoring.refusal: answers that decline or say there is not enough information are 'unable_to_answer' (checked by pattern list in scoring.py)
scoring.unsupported_claim: NOT assessed automatically; raw outputs preserved for human audit

tasks.natural_language_question: What were my total sales in January 2025?
tasks.aggregation_definition: sales = sum(quantity x unit price) of the recorded lines; GST treatment of the recorded rate is not known

tolerance.rule: correct if |answer - truth| <= max(0.5% of truth, INR 1)

tasks.natural_language_question: How much did I sell in February 2025 in total?
tasks.aggregation_definition: sales = sum(quantity x unit price) of the recorded lines; GST treatment of the recorded rate is not known

tolerance.rule: correct if |answer - truth| <= max(0.5% of truth, INR 1)

tasks.natural_language_question: What were my total sales for the three months from January to March 2025?
tasks.aggregation_definition: sales = sum(quantity x unit price) of the recorded lines; GST treatment of the recorded rate is not known

tolerance.rule: correct if |answer - truth| <= max(0.5% of truth, INR 1)

tasks.natural_language_question: How many units did I sell in March 2025?
tasks.aggregation_definition: units = sum of quantity

tolerance.rule: correct only if the integer equals the truth

tasks.natural_language_question: How many units did I sell in February 2025?
tasks.aggregation_definition: units = sum of quantity

tolerance.rule: correct only if the integer equals the truth

tasks.natural_language_question: How did February 2025 sales compare with January? Tell me the percentage change.
tasks.aggregation_definition: (Feb total - Jan total) / Jan total x 100

tolerance.rule: correct if |answer - truth| <= 0.5 percentage points

tasks.natural_language_question: By what percentage did sales change in March 2025 compared with February 2025?
tasks.aggregation_definition: (Mar total - Feb total) / Feb total x 100

tolerance.rule: correct if |answer - truth| <= 0.5 percentage points

tasks.natural_language_question: Which day had the highest total sales between January and March 2025?
tasks.aggregation_definition: calendar day with the largest daily total

tolerance.rule: the first candidate entity named in the answer must equal the truth

tasks.natural_language_question: Which day had the lowest total sales between January and March 2025, counting only days that have any sales recorded?
tasks.aggregation_definition: calendar day with the smallest daily total among days with >=1 sale

tolerance.rule: the first candidate entity named in the answer must equal the truth

tasks.natural_language_question: How did sales from 1 to 15 March 2025 compare with 1 to 15 February 2025, as a percentage change?
tasks.aggregation_definition: (1-15 Mar total - 1-15 Feb total) / 1-15 Feb total x 100

tolerance.rule: correct if |answer - truth| <= 0.5 percentage points

tasks.natural_language_question: Which product sold the most units in February 2025?
tasks.aggregation_definition: product with the largest unit total

tolerance.rule: the first candidate entity named in the answer must equal the truth

tasks.natural_language_question: What were my top 3 products by sales value from January to March 2025?
tasks.aggregation_definition: products ranked by revenue

tolerance.rule: primary: exact ordered match of the 3 products

tasks.natural_language_question: Which three products sold the most units in March 2025?
tasks.aggregation_definition: products ranked by units

tolerance.rule: primary: exact ordered match of the 3 products

tasks.natural_language_question: How many units of BIG ONION did I sell between January and March 2025?
tasks.aggregation_definition: sum of quantity for the named product

tolerance.rule: correct only if the integer equals the truth

tasks.natural_language_question: Which sold more units between January and March 2025, BIG ONION or MILK?
tasks.aggregation_definition: larger unit total wins

tolerance.rule: the first candidate entity named in the answer must equal the truth

tasks.natural_language_question: What share of my total sales came from EGG from January to March 2025? Give a percentage.
tasks.aggregation_definition: product revenue / total revenue x 100

tolerance.rule: correct if |answer - truth| <= 0.5 percentage points

tasks.natural_language_question: Which day of the week brings in the most sales for me?
tasks.aggregation_definition: weekday with the largest total sales over the whole period

tolerance.rule: the first candidate entity named in the answer must equal the truth

tasks.natural_language_question: Which day of the week is my weakest for sales?
tasks.aggregation_definition: weekday with the smallest total sales over the whole period

tolerance.rule: the first candidate entity named in the answer must equal the truth

tasks.natural_language_question: How much did I sell on Sundays in total between January and March 2025?
tasks.aggregation_definition: sales = sum(quantity x unit price) of the recorded lines; GST treatment of the recorded rate is not known; summed over all Sundays

tolerance.rule: correct if |answer - truth| <= max(0.5% of truth, INR 1)

tasks.natural_language_question: On an average day that I had sales, how much did I sell between January and March 2025?
tasks.aggregation_definition: mean of daily totals over days with at least one sale

tolerance.rule: correct if |answer - truth| <= max(0.5% of truth, INR 1)

tasks.natural_language_question: How many different products did I sell in January 2025?
tasks.aggregation_definition: count of distinct product names

tolerance.rule: correct only if the integer equals the truth

tasks.natural_language_question: On an average day that I had sales, how many units did I sell in March 2025?
tasks.aggregation_definition: mean of daily unit totals over days with at least one sale

tolerance.rule: correct if |answer - truth| <= max(0.5% of truth, 0.5)

tasks.natural_language_question: What was the highest total sales I made on any single day between January and March 2025?
tasks.aggregation_definition: maximum daily total over days in the window

tolerance.rule: correct if |answer - truth| <= max(0.5% of truth, INR 1)

tasks.natural_language_question: How much of my sales between January and March 2025 came from items with 5% GST?
tasks.aggregation_definition: sales = sum(quantity x unit price) of the recorded lines; GST treatment of the recorded rate is not known; lines whose recorded GST slab is 5%

tolerance.rule: correct if |answer - truth| <= max(0.5% of truth, INR 1)

tasks.notes: GST is not representable in DecisionGPT's canonical sales schema; the LLM baseline receives gst_pct only on this track.

tasks.natural_language_question: What percentage of my sales came from items with 18% GST?
tasks.aggregation_definition: revenue of 18% lines / total revenue x 100

tolerance.rule: correct if |answer - truth| <= 0.5 percentage points

tasks.natural_language_question: What percentage of my sales came from items with 0% GST?
tasks.aggregation_definition: revenue of 0% lines / total revenue x 100

tolerance.rule: correct if |answer - truth| <= 0.5 percentage points

tasks.natural_language_question: Which GST rate brought in the most sales between January and March 2025?
tasks.aggregation_definition: GST slab with the largest total sales

tolerance.rule: the first candidate entity named in the answer must equal the truth
